tests.description: Timed check on Units of Information

questions.question: How many bytes are in 3.5 KB?
A text file contains 2,000 characters stored in ASCII (1 byte per character). What is the file size in KB?
questions.explanation: Answer: 2,000 characters x 1 byte = 2,000 bytes = 2,000 / 1,000 = 2 KB.

questions.question: Calculate the size of a 640x480 pixel image with 8-bit colour depth in KB.
Which is larger: 0.5 GB or 600 MB? Show your working.
questions.correctAnswer: 0.5 GB = 0.5 x 1,000 = 500 MB. 600 MB > 500 MB, so 600 MB is larger.
